text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's signature racewear has
arrived.
Umamusume can customize their
racewear to
their own preferences, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Preferences? I don't have any... Or
maybe, except
one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Try and guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa smiles mischievously.
She must
be testing my perceptivity.
What could be her
one preference?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait a second. Don't guess. Let's
make this a
game. If you win, I'll tell you
the answer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The rules will be simple. And we'll be
playing with
these.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa takes three dice out of
her
pocket and rolls them on the table.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each die lands on a different number.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess how many times you'll roll
duplicates, then
roll the dice five times.
It's not the most exciting
game, but it'll
kill time before training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And if you lose... hm... I'll come up with
something
then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, you in?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah! That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Remember, it's all in the name of fun.
So, let's
enjoy ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, c'mon. What's there to think about?
You
have two choices: play or don't
play.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But unless you're a coward, you really
only have
one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right. Good.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, tell me... How many times do you
think
you'll roll a duplicate?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is all about probability. And if I
think about
it... rolling the dice just five
times won't really
result in any matching
numbers... perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But going against Nakayama Festa, she
could
practically roll whatever number
she wants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No... Even if she could, it wouldn't be
like her to
rig the game.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's a boring guess. But, whatever you
say,
you're the one rolling.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think I'd be the one rolling, even
though
that shouldn't change the odds.
Well, here I go—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That takes some skill, Trainer.
Who
thought you'd throw that on your
first roll?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every single die on the table is a "one."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't start thinking I tried anything
slick.
These are just the numbers that
came up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And a game's a game. You lost.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's better than not having made
the bet at
all and being bored.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's not about luck or probability. When
you're
the one rolling the dice...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It's a battle with yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though I lost the game, Nakayama
Festa
tells me her one preference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of competition, risk, and
following the
path to victory are things
she values deeply. In
other words, the
thrill of rolling the dice...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah! And since you lost... Hm... I know,
I'm gonna
burn you with an intense game
this time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's get out to the track, Trainer. That's
where
we'll have our next showdown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Don't be a bore, okay?
